name: Touching Yourself
overview: Scripture addresses the topic of touching oneself with a call to holiness and self-control, emphasizing the seriousness of actions that lead to uncleanness or cause others to stumble. Leviticus 15:16 highlights the physical impurity associated with the emission of seed, while Mark 9:43 warns believers to remove anything that causes sin, even if it means personal sacrifice. Believers are encouraged to walk after the Spirit, not the flesh, as stated in Romans 8:1, and to focus their minds on things that are pure and honorable according to Philippians 4:8. Galatians 6:7 reminds us that our actions have consequences, urging careful consideration of how we live in light of God's judgment.
